sources.snippet: To bridge this gap, we propose FCLM, a large multimodal model designed to jointly support fine-grained visual understanding through consistency learning. The central premise is that pixel-level captioning and grounding are mutually beneficial and complementary, each enhancing the other in achieving a fine-grained understanding of visual content.
